description: AsyncLocalStorage and the TC39 AsyncContext API for browsers: the context stays through await, then, timers, events and generators.
Procedures as data for TypeScript: one typed call model for in-process, HTTP, WebSocket, CLI and MCP (Claude) — with streaming, middleware and a visual composer.
A base for declarative languages: a document gets its meaning from a question. Its kind names the evaluator, and a ladder finds it.
polite-crawler: a polite web crawler for research and AI agents. Fetch once, keep it, read it many times. robots.txt, one request per site, full-text search, MCP server.
Composable graph and tree layout for TypeScript. Select a layout for each container, and get boxes and routed edges for SVG, Canvas, the DOM or React Flow.
Main-thread lag monitoring for browser apps: event loop lag, long tasks, Long Animation Frames, hangs, INP and Web Vitals from real users, as OpenTelemetry metrics, events and traces.

The Page Lifecycle API state of a web page (active, passive, hidden, frozen, terminated) for monitoring and telemetry libraries: one shared tracker, observers before exporters, back/forward cache restores.
A reactive expression engine for TypeScript whose interface renders its own expressions: ordered epochs, classes as data, and a live editor.
How long until a client knows that its peer is gone: computed by an algebra, measured by a harness.

Typed spreadsheet formulas over TypeScript objects: one formula evaluated at each record, axes over related records, sheets with cycle detection, and an error value with a reason instead of an exception.
